_doc: Runtime budget for the ci.yml `web` job (design 06 §6.3, wave PV8).
calibrated=false: the seconds below are DESIGN ESTIMATES, not anchors —
the first real CI run of the web job (RC-1 push) measures the actual
values; the calibration commit then sets calibrated=true and replaces
the numbers with the measured reference (§6.3: the gate compares against
the calibrated budget, never against the design estimate).
Until calibrated, the budget step only reports + annotates (no red).
job_fail_seconds is a design CONSTANT (fail > 10 min), active regardless
of calibration; timeout-minutes: 12 on the job is the hard deck above it.
Sharding trigger: three consecutive runs over e2e_budget_seconds =>
